# Perplexity Agent

Use `perplexity-agent/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "perplexity-agent-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "perplexity-agent/anthropic/claude-fable-5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai`

## Default base URL

`https://api.perplexity.ai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `PERPLEXITY_AGENT_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/models
